findings.description: Both required list pages were downloaded with the exact brief URLs. The default and ?section=tables responses are byte-identical (same SHA-256), so the query string did not change content. The three official directory/profile pages cited for courtesy checks were also downloaded with curl.

Enumeration: 28 main faculty cards parsed (name and title) and 19 table names (Emeritus 6, Courtesy 7, Adjunct 6). All 47 names match brief.people exactly once after honorific/parenthetical normalization; no omissions and no extra names on the pages.

Profile pages were not individually retrieved for the 19 table-only people because the official list page links none of them. Courtesy ranks were checked against the official College of Engineering directory, the TECO-CERC directory and the Pyayt profile. Search-engine snippets were not cited and were not used as evidence.
